name: DuckDB原始TXT读取
sql:
CREATE TEMP TABLE wide AS
SELECT *
FROM read_csv('reports/electricity-20261008/LD2011_2014.txt',
    delim=';',
    header=TRUE,
    all_varchar=TRUE,
    sample_size=-1
);

name: DuckDB宽表展开并保留NULL
sql:
CREATE TEMP TABLE readings AS
SELECT
    TRY_STRPTIME("column000", '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') AS ts,
    client,
    raw_value,
    TRY_CAST(REPLACE(raw_value, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) AS value
FROM wide
UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (
    raw_value FOR client IN (COLUMNS(* EXCLUDE ("column000")))
);

name: 完整数据质量与粒度核验
sql:
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wide) AS time_rows,
    COUNT(*) AS long_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT client) AS clients,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ts) AS unique_timestamps,
    MIN(ts) AS min_time,
    MAX(ts) AS max_time,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ts IS NULL) AS bad_timestamp_cells,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE raw_value IS NULL OR TRIM(raw_value) = '') AS blank_cells,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE raw_value IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(raw_value) != '' AND value IS NULL) AS bad_numeric_cells,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value = 0) AS zero_cells,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value < 0) AS negative_cells,
    MIN(value) AS min_value,
    MAX(value) AS max_value
FROM readings;

name: 时间频率与重复时点
sql:
WITH times AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ts
    FROM readings
),
intervals AS (
    SELECT
        ts,
        DATE_DIFF('minute', LAG(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts), ts) AS step_minutes
    FROM times
)
SELECT
    step_minutes,
    COUNT(*) AS interval_count
FROM intervals
GROUP BY step_minutes
ORDER BY interval_count DESC, step_minutes
LIMIT 20;

name: 同一时点与客户重复检查
sql:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS duplicated_keys
FROM (
    SELECT ts, client
    FROM readings
    GROUP BY ts, client
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) d;
